svg.title: Cross-Backbone Stability of Architecture Effects
svg.desc: Three aligned panels compare Qwen and DeepSeek target-minus-baseline effects for Token F1, Strict Accuracy, and Soft Semantic Score across six architecture contrasts. A dashed vertical line marks zero effect.

text.tspan: Mean target-minus-baseline effects in percentage points; paired markers show directional reproduction
Strict and Soft guide the primary quality interpretation; Token F1 is a lexical diagnostic. Each effect uses N=60.
Connectors join two within-backbone point estimates; they are not uncertainty intervals or significance tests.
Directional stability is descriptive across the two tested pipelines and does not imply universal invariance.
